shortDescription: Retrieve a repository from a distant location and make it available on the execution node

options.name: branch
options.description: Details about the new branch that will be created

options.name: host_key_checking
options.description: Configure strict host key checking for ssh based connections accept-new will accept new host keys (StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new) no will disable strict host key checking (StrictHostKeyChecking=no) system will use the global system setting and not configure the git repository yes will enable strict host key checking (StrictHostKeyChecking=yes)

options.name: parent_directory
options.description: The local directory where the repository will be placed If the parent directory does not exist, it will be created

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds for each command issued
